topic: Heavy bags: how should you carry them?
caption:
Always carry your bag on the same shoulder? 🎒
One-sided load keeps the same muscles working all day.

✔ Lighten the load
✔ Both backpack straps, snug and high
✔ Alternate sides with shoulder bags
